description: Get transactions for the company with optional filters. Returns currency, amount_gbp and exchange_rate. A row with expected_income: true is an uploaded sales invoice still waiting to be paid, NOT money received: leave it out of any cash, income received or bank balance figure. For currency-split income totals prefer get_income_by_currency.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

max_confidence.description: Only lines whose categorisation confidence is below this percentage (0 to 100). Lines with no confidence score are included.

needs_review.description: Only the lines Finn could not place with confidence: the same set as the 'transactions need a look' count.

offset.description: Skip this many rows (default 0) for pagination

name: get_transactions
title: Get Transactions
